nodes.question: How did Lenski (2000) conceptualize everyday life, and what are the three aspects she identified?
nodes.answer: Lenski proposed that everyday life is the essential continuum of mundane activities and conceptualized it as comprising time (repetition/routine), space (home), and modality (habit).
